content.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell gaseous form} spell for 1 hour (no {@status concentration} required) or until you end the effect as a bonus action. This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.

content.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Gaseous Form|SRD52} spell for 1 hour (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required) or until you end the effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.
This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.
